notes:
Topline: PitchLoop is a mid-market sales engagement platform (800 employees, HQ SF) building an outbound SDR chat assistant that performs CRM lookups, composes/send emails, schedules meetings, and surfaces account context in real time. Evaluating Redwood hosted API for fast time-to-value; long-term goal Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC scope requested: 4-week hosted API pilot to validate streaming latency, tool-calling reliability, and integration patterns. Target: 20 concurrent SDR agents, avg session length 3–5 min, peak message throughput ~250 messages/min. SLO: streaming end-to-end per-message latency <200ms token latency preferred; initial acceptable threshold 300ms. Must support function/tool calling to: HubSpot CRM (read/write), Gmail/Office365 send + calendar write, internal billing lookup service. Structured responses required for downstream action routing (JSON/typed).

Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for product admins, audit logs for all outbound sends, retention controls (90/365 day options), optional BYOK/KMS for Dedicated. Data residency question: EU region for some EU customers; plan to segregate EU accounts in Dedicated later. Legal flagged contract language around ML training and data retention — DMCA/PII handling clarifications needed.

Commercials: Interested in hosted API to shorten evaluation time. If POC goes well, they'd commit to Dedicated reserved capacity for ~500 agents in Q3 2026. Estimated ARR range provided above; finance wants clear cost per active agent and unit token economics.
